correctness.rationale: The actual twelve-vertex icosahedral graph with 30 edges (two pentagonal belts plus two apices) and the four-state threshold-one simultaneous excitation rule were reconstructed. An independent C++ full functional-graph computation traversed all 4^12=16,777,216 labelled states, finding exactly one fixed point and 208,850 primitive period-four cycles, 835,400 rotating periodic states, fixed basin 3,620,436, 20 nonempty joint depth/period classes, maximum depth ten achieved by 240 states and no other periods; hence F^14=F^10. Independent local successor-coloring count matches 835,400. NetworkX complete graph-isomorphism enumeration gives full automorphism group size 120 and exactly two size-120 extremal orbits represented by base-four codes 75769 and 441799. The exhaustive finite-state proof is valid only for this specified graph; the connected-graph rotation lemma alone does not prove the ten-step bound.
residual_risks: Exact statement confined to q=4 on the 12-vertex icosahedron; no result for all regular graphs.
